ns2:section.sectionText: ENG 451 SW1 is an online course worth two hours of credit and counts toward the Other Social Sciences/Humanities requirement for engineering students. This course is restricted to students who have a career-related internship or co-op during the Summer 2013 term. If you do not meet this requirement you will be disqualified from the course. Please contact Sarah Zehr at szehr@illinois.edu or 217-333-1960 with questions about this policy.
